role: Developmental consolidation engine for organic language acquisition; evaluates heard phrases and promotes them to speakable production via CAN_PRODUCE edges.
detail: PhraseConsolidator runs maintenance cycles that process all PhraseNodes, recalculating confidence with per-type decay (d=0.03 or 0.015 if unconsolidated), incrementing encounter_count once per cycle when heard since last retrieval, adding 0.5 rehearsal credits per cycle (converts to encounter when >=1.0), computing weighted readiness scores with hard floor of 3 encounters, promoting to CAN_PRODUCE when readiness>=threshold, extracting discriminative context from HEARD_DURING edges, clustering phrase variants by word overlap (threshold 0.6), and promoting high-frequency words (3+ phrases, 10+ encounters) to standalone CAN_PRODUCE edges. Key classes: PhraseConsolidator (main orchestrator), PhraseReadiness (per-node metrics), PhraseConsolidationReport (cycle summary). Critical thresholds: INTERNAL_REHEARSAL_WEIGHT=0.5, UNCONSOLIDATED_DECAY_FACTOR=0.5, CROSS_SESSION_SPACING_BONUS=1.5, CLUSTER_OVERLAP_THRESHOLD=0.6, WORD_MIN_PHRASE_COUNT=3, WORD_MIN_TOTAL_ENCOUNTERS=10. Reconsolidation lability window (10min) amplifies confidence gains when phrase recently retrieved. Function-word exclusion list prevents standalone production of articles/particles.
gotchas: Drive variance and contextual consistency scoring defaulted to 1.0 (pass-through) pending edge-data analysis; discriminative context coerces all HEARD_DURING snapshot values to float during aggregation; word promotion skips function words defined in _FUNCTION_WORDS frozenset; clustering uses greedy single-linkage (any existing member's overlap>=threshold adds new phrase to cluster); phrase_nodes list reused across clustering and word-promotion passes assumes no modifications between calls.
